sections.title: 10-Day Pickleball Adventure in Barcelona
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Pickleball and Culture in Barcelona

Experience the vibrant city of Barcelona while enjoying daily pickleball sessions led by professionals. Explore iconic sites such as the Gothic Quarter, Sagrada Família, Montserrat, and the Palau de la Música Catalana. Savor Catalan cuisine, visit renowned wineries, and discover the charm of coastal Sitges on this immersive 10-day adventure.

Guided visit to the Sagrada Família

In the afternoon, guided visit to the Sagrada Família. Construction of this major work by Gaudí began in 1882, and it remained unfinished at the artist’s death in 1926. Work has continued thanks to donations and visitors, including Subirachs’s Passion Façade, new towers, and colorful stained-glass windows inside. Guided exterior visit followed by admission to the interior.

Guided visit to the Palau de la Musica Catalana

In the afternoon, guided visit to the Palau de la Música Catalana. Still in use today, this breathtaking concert hall was designed by architect Domènech i Montaner, a major figure in Modernism and a teacher of Gaudí. A UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is renowned for its exuberant stained glass, mosaics, and sculptures.

Hands-on cooking class with professional chefs

In the late afternoon, enjoy a hands-on cooking class led by professional chefs at a specially equipped venue in central Barcelona. Each participant prepares a traditional Spanish dish with guidance from the chefs. Afterwards, everyone shares and enjoys the dishes they have made; drinks are included and self-served in a relaxed, home-like atmosphere.

sections.title: Day 8 - Excursion
sections.html:
After breakfast, depart for a visit to the renowned Torres wineries

After breakfast, depart for a visit to the renowned Torres wineries, a leading name in Catalan winemaking. Tour the extensive facilities and taste a selection of the estate’s wines.

Torres wineries tour and tasting

Tour the extensive facilities of Torres wineries and taste a selection of the estate’s wines.

Lunch at El Celleret restaurant

After the visit, enjoy lunch at El Celleret restaurant, located on the estate. The menus showcase Catalan culinary culture, accompanied by Torres wines.

Continue to Sitges

After lunch, continue to Sitges, a charming coastal town south of Barcelona and one of the most pleasant destinations on the Catalan coast.

Guided walk in Sitges

Enjoy a short guided walk in Sitges followed by free time to round out the afternoon.
